sources.title: June 2026 Piracy and armed robbery report
sources.text: Duty officer onboard an anchored bulk carrier noticed several small boats near the forward of the vessel and notified the bosun to check. After several minutes, on not receiving any response from the bosun, the duty officer raised the alarm. Crew mustered and proceeded to the forecastle where they saw the bosun tied up. Seven robbers armed with knives were seen escaping from the forecastle store. On investigating ships properties were reported as stolen. Incident reported to Belawan VTS, Coast Guard and the local agent.
